The '''Ryvester system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]].
